fire: Back in the days when Mozart was a small boy, he already toured the courts of Europe.

The village looked much the same when Napoleon was a young officer.
This bridge already stood when Shakespeare was writing his first plays.
In 1702, fifty years after Galileo's death, the book was reprinted.
The farm had been in the family since before the Lincolns were married.
